propositions: Eval pass reproducibility is confounded when Pass-1 and Pass-2 evaluate against different model classes (Sonnet vs. Opus) than production uses, since model capability differences mask change-driven deltas.

Mixed-model chains collapse prompt_cache_style to 'none' via _intersect_capabilities, dropping cache read tokens to zero and doubling review cost because fallback_targets_for re-derives the fallback chain from rebar.toml on every call.

Ephemeral fallback-free rebar.toml configs must be created per pinned pass in temp directories so that resolve_pinned_model and later callers achieve genuinely homogeneous chains without Anthropic-direct fallbacks.
Corpus sidecar rows must surface ran_model from provider_provenance to enable parity verification and cache effectiveness checks by later tier1/tier2 tickets.
A stable mechanism is needed to stamp and verify per-pass model identity across result dicts and to classify cache effectiveness from usage-log rows.
